ext_name.description: Extension name, shown in the Chrome Web Store, chrome://extensions, and the panel title. Keep identical in every locale.

ext_description.message: Highlight evidence sentences in research papers and PDFs from your question and concepts — private, nothing sent to the developer.
ext_description.description: Extension description shown in the store and on chrome://extensions.

command_toggle_pause.message: Pause or resume Evidence Highlighter scanning
command_toggle_pause.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Evidence Highlighter is the product short name; keep it.

panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the side panel.

panel_subtitle.message: Candidate evidence for quick academic review.

scan_state_on.description: Scan state indicator when automatic scanning is active.

scan_state_paused.description: Scan state indicator when scanning is paused.

upgrade_note.message: Scanning now starts on scholarly pages only. You can change this below.
upgrade_note.description: One-time note shown after the 0.17 update.

dismiss_button.description: Button that dismisses the upgrade note.

dismiss_aria.description: Accessible label for the dismiss button.

label_auto_scanning.description: Label for the scan mode dropdown.

scan_mode_scholarly.description: Scan mode option: only pages recognized as scholarly are scanned automatically.

scan_mode_all.description: Scan mode option: any page the user opens may be scanned automatically.

scan_mode_manual.description: Scan mode option: nothing is scanned until the user clicks Scan. 'Scan' refers to the Scan page button.

scan_privacy_hint.message: Scholarly pages only skips unrecognized pages unless you choose a one-time scan. Any page or a manual scan can read visible text on the page you choose, including email or chat messages. Scrolling on eligible pages can scan newly loaded text.
scan_privacy_hint.description: Privacy hint under the scan mode dropdown. 'Scholarly pages only' and 'Any page' are scan mode names; 'Scan' refers to the Scan page button.

label_question.description: Label for the research question field.

placeholder_question.message: How is forest cover related to tick abundance?
placeholder_question.description: Do NOT translate: example input text. The system matches English input, so this example stays English in all locales.

hint_page_search.message: Page searches update these fields when the site exposes the selected query. If they don’t, paste it here and click Scan page.
hint_page_search.description: Hint under the research question field. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

label_concept1.description: Label for the first concept field.

placeholder_concept1.description: Do NOT translate: example input text. The system matches English input, so this example stays English in all locales.

label_concept2.description: Label for the second concept field.

placeholder_concept2.description: Do NOT translate: example input text. The system matches English input, so this example stays English in all locales.

label_extra_terms.description: Label for the extra terms field.

placeholder_extra_terms.description: Do NOT translate: example input text. The system matches English input, so this example stays English in all locales.

button_scan_page.description: Main button that scans the current page.

button_scan_page_once.description: Button for a one-time scan while automatic scanning is paused or manual.

button_scan_pdf.description: Button that opens a file picker for a saved PDF.

button_clear.description: Button that clears search fields, results, and page highlights.

status_initial.message: Search any page or enter a research question. Scrolling can load and scan more page content when automatic scanning is enabled.
status_initial.description: Initial status line shown before any scan.

session_hint.message: Results stay in memory for each open tab and return when you switch back. Feeds load content gradually; scroll at a pace that lets each section be scanned. Reloading, closing the tab, or navigating to another page clears that page’s memory. Export CSV if you need to keep a copy. Nothing is saved to a results database.
session_hint.description: Explanatory paragraph about per-tab result memory. 'Export CSV' refers to the Export CSV button.

count_candidates.description: Caption next to the result count when results are candidate sentences.

count_video_titles.description: Caption next to the result count when results are only video titles.

count_shown_candidates.description: Caption when a filter hides some results. $1 is the total number of candidate sentences found.

count_shown_titles.description: Caption when a filter hides some results and all results are video titles. $1 is the total number of video titles found.

button_export_csv.description: Button that downloads results as a CSV file. Keep 'CSV' as-is.

paused_title.description: Title of the paused-scan dialog and of the paused empty state.

dialog_paused_body.message: Resume scanning and scan this page now? This will turn off Pause scanning.
dialog_paused_body.description: Body of the paused-scan dialog. 'Pause scanning' is the pause button label.

dialog_keep_paused.description: Dialog button that keeps scanning paused.

dialog_resume_scan.description: Dialog button that resumes scanning and scans the page.

sort_paper_order.description: Sort option: results in the order they appear in the paper.

sort_compatibility.description: Sort option: results sorted by compatibility score, highest first.

label_show.description: Label for the results filter dropdown.

filter_no_refs.description: Filter option: show all results except reference entries.

filter_high.description: Filter option: show only high-confidence results.

filter_medium.description: Filter option: show medium- and high-confidence results.

filter_low.description: Filter option: show only low-confidence results.

filter_reference.description: Filter option: show only reference entries.

filter_all_refs.description: Filter option: show all results including reference entries.

status_search_updated_paused.message: Updated the research question from this page’s search. Automatic scanning is paused; click Scan this page once to scan.
status_search_updated_paused.description: Status after the question is auto-filled from a page search while paused. 'Scan this page once' is the one-time scan button label.

status_search_updated.message: Updated the research question from this page’s search. Click Scan page when you’re ready.
status_search_updated.description: Status after the question is auto-filled from a page search. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

status_scrolling.message: Scanning the loaded page content. Keep scrolling to load more; results from earlier content stay here.
status_scrolling.description: Status shown while a feed page is scanned as the user scrolls.

status_paused_saved.message: Scanning is paused. Your research question is saved.
status_paused_saved.description: Status shown on a paused page.

status_manual_off.message: Automatic scanning is off for this page. Click Scan page to scan it once.
status_manual_off.description: Status shown on a page when automatic scanning is set to manual. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

status_new_page_auto.message: New page detected. Auto-scanning with the current research question...
status_new_page_auto.description: Status when a new page is detected and auto-scanning starts.

status_new_page_prompt.message: New page detected. Enter a research question or search Scholar to start scanning.
status_new_page_prompt.description: Status when a new page is detected but no question or concepts are set. 'Scholar' refers to Google Scholar; keep it as 'Scholar'.

status_scanning_visible.description: Status during a manual scan of visible article text.

status_local_pdf_viewer.message: Chrome is showing a local PDF viewer. Use Scan saved PDF to choose the downloaded file directly.
status_local_pdf_viewer.description: Status when the tab is a local PDF in Chrome's viewer. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

status_trying_pdf_link.message: No page-text matches. Trying the first PDF link...
status_trying_pdf_link.description: Status when no page text matched and the extension falls back to the first PDF link.

status_pdf_scanned.message: Scanned PDF text. Built-in PDF viewers cannot be highlighted yet, so review the evidence cards here.
status_pdf_scanned.description: Status after scanning PDF text that cannot be highlighted in the viewer.

status_pdf_no_text.message: Could not extract useful PDF text. Some journal PDFs are protected, image-only, or compressed beyond this prototype.
status_pdf_no_text.description: Status when no useful text could be extracted from a PDF.

status_youtube_titles_one.message: Found $1 YouTube video title matching your terms. Titles are not evidence; open a video description or transcript to scan study content.
status_youtube_titles_one.description: Status when exactly one YouTube video title matched. $1 is the number 1. Keep 'YouTube' as-is.

status_youtube_titles_many.message: Found $1 YouTube video titles matching your terms. Titles are not evidence; open a video description or transcript to scan study content.
status_youtube_titles_many.description: Status when more than one YouTube video title matched. $1 is the count. Keep 'YouTube' as-is.

status_found_one.message: Scanned the content loaded so far and found $1 candidate sentence. On feeds, keep scrolling to load and scan more; earlier results stay here. Verify each candidate.
status_found_one.description: Status when exactly one candidate sentence was found. $1 is the number 1.

status_found_many.message: Scanned the content loaded so far and found $1 candidate sentences. On feeds, keep scrolling to load and scan more; earlier results stay here. Verify each candidate.
status_found_many.description: Status when more than one candidate sentence was found. $1 is the count.

status_scanned_once_paused.message: Scanned this page once. Automatic scanning is still paused.
status_scanned_once_paused.description: Status after a one-time scan while paused.

status_paused_cleared.message: Scanning paused. Current results and page highlights were cleared.
status_paused_cleared.description: Status after pausing, when results and highlights were cleared.

status_resumed.message: Scanning resumed. Checking this page now...

status_manual_off_generic.message: Automatic scanning is off. Click Scan page whenever you want to scan.
status_manual_off_generic.description: Status after switching automatic scanning to manual. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

status_skip_no_read.message: Automatic scan skipped without reading this page. Choose Scan this page once if you want to scan it.
status_skip_no_read.description: Status when an automatic scan was skipped for a non-scholarly page. 'Scan this page once' is the one-time scan button label.

status_scanning_saved_pdf.description: Status while a saved PDF file is scanned. $1 is the file name, shown verbatim and never translated.

status_saved_pdf_scanned.message: Scanned the saved PDF locally and extracted $1 text characters. Review evidence cards here; local PDFs cannot be page-highlighted yet.
status_saved_pdf_scanned.description: Status after a saved PDF was scanned. $1 is the extracted character count, already formatted.

status_saved_pdf_no_text.message: I could not extract readable text from this PDF. It may be scanned images, encrypted, or too compressed for this prototype parser.
status_saved_pdf_no_text.description: Status when a saved PDF has no extractable text.

status_saved_pdf_no_candidates.message: Extracted $1 text characters, but found no candidates for the current question. Try broader terms or a different question.
status_saved_pdf_no_candidates.description: Status when a saved PDF had text but no matches. $1 is the extracted character count, already formatted.

status_saved_pdf_failed.description: Status when scanning a saved PDF failed. $1 is the browser error text, shown verbatim and never translated.

status_cleared.message: Cleared search fields, results, and page highlights.

status_pdf_page_opened.message: Opened PDF page $1. Built-in PDF viewers cannot show extension highlights yet.
status_pdf_page_opened.description: Status after jumping to a PDF page. $1 is the page number.

status_pdf_page_local.message: This result is on PDF page $1. Local saved PDFs cannot be jumped/highlighted yet.
status_pdf_page_local.description: Status for a result in a local saved PDF. $1 is the page number.

status_pdf_no_jump.message: This result came from extracted PDF text, so there is no page highlight to jump to yet.
status_pdf_no_jump.description: Status for a result with no page highlight target.

status_highlight_not_found.message: I could not find that exact highlight on the page. Try scanning this page again.
status_highlight_not_found.description: Status when a highlight cannot be found on the page.

status_highlight_jump_failed.message: I could not jump to that page highlight. Try scanning this page again.
status_highlight_jump_failed.description: Status when jumping to a highlight fails.

status_prefill_updated.message: Updated the research question and concepts from this page’s search. You can edit them or scan now.
status_prefill_updated.description: Status after the question and concepts are filled from a page search.

status_saved_intent.message: Using your saved search intent. Page titles will not replace your concepts.
status_saved_intent.description: Status when the saved question and concepts are used instead of a page suggestion.

status_pdf_links_one.message: Found $1 PDF link. This prototype can detect them, but it cannot yet read protected PDF viewers directly.
status_pdf_links_one.description: Status when exactly one PDF link was found. $1 is the number 1. Keep 'PDF' as-is.

status_pdf_links_many.message: Found $1 PDF links. This prototype can detect them, but it cannot yet read protected PDF viewers directly.
status_pdf_links_many.description: Status when more than one PDF link was found. $1 is the count. Keep 'PDF' as-is.

status_no_query.message: I couldn’t read a search query from this page. Enter a research question or click Scan page to scan with your saved terms.
status_no_query.description: Status when no search query could be read from the page. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

status_fetching_pdf.description: Status while fetching PDF text from a URL. Keep 'PDF' as-is.

status_scan_failed.description: Status when a scan fails with an unexpected error. $1 is the browser error text, shown verbatim and never translated.

empty_auto_paused_title.description: Empty state title shown when automatic scanning is paused.

empty_auto_paused_msg.message: This page has not been read for scanning. Your research question is saved.
empty_auto_paused_msg.description: Empty state message shown when automatic scanning is paused.

empty_manual_title.message: Automatic scanning is set to manual
empty_manual_title.description: Empty state title shown when automatic scanning is set to manual.

empty_manual_msg_short.message: This page is not read unless you choose Scan page.
empty_manual_msg_short.description: Empty state message for manual mode on a new page. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

empty_manual_msg_long.message: The extension will not read pages until you click Scan page. Your research question and concepts stay saved.
empty_manual_msg_long.description: Empty state message after switching to manual mode. 'Scan page' is the Scan page button label.

empty_unsupported_title.message: Chrome does not allow scanning this page
empty_unsupported_title.description: Empty state title for pages Chrome extensions cannot read, such as settings pages.

empty_unsupported_msg.message: Chrome does not allow extensions to read this kind of page (for example, Chrome settings or the Chrome Web Store). Open the article in a regular webpage, or download its PDF and use Scan saved PDF.
empty_unsupported_msg.description: Empty state message and status for unreadable page types. Keep 'Chrome Web Store' as-is. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

empty_localpdf_title.message: This PDF viewer can’t be scanned directly
empty_localpdf_title.description: Empty state title for Chrome's built-in PDF viewer. Keep 'PDF' as-is.

empty_localpdf_msg.message: Chrome’s built-in PDF viewer does not expose its text to this extension. Download the PDF, then choose it with Scan saved PDF.
empty_localpdf_msg.description: Empty state message and status for the built-in PDF viewer. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

empty_layout_title.message: This page layout is not supported yet
empty_layout_title.description: Empty state title when the page text cannot be separated into readable blocks.

empty_layout_msg.message: The browser page contains visible text, but the scanner could not separate it into readable text blocks. This site’s layout is not fully supported yet; this is an extension compatibility limitation, not proof that Chrome blocked access. Try selecting and copying the text into a document or opening a simpler text view.
empty_layout_msg.description: Empty state message when the page layout is not supported.

empty_unreadable_title.message: The extension could not read this page
empty_unreadable_title.description: Empty state title when the page text could not be read at all.

empty_unreadable_msg.message: The extension could not read text from this page. Chrome or the site may restrict access, or the page may use a protected viewer or frame. If this is an article, try its full-text page or download the PDF and use Scan saved PDF.
empty_unreadable_msg.description: Empty state message when the page text could not be read. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

empty_youtube_title.description: Empty state title for YouTube search pages with no matching titles. Keep 'YouTube' as-is.

empty_youtube_msg.message: YouTube search results mainly contain video titles. None matched your current terms strongly enough to show. Titles are not evidence; open a video description or transcript and scan that text for study findings.
empty_youtube_msg.description: Empty state message for YouTube search pages with no matching titles. Keep 'YouTube' as-is.

empty_nomatch_title.description: Empty state title when readable text had no matching sentences.

empty_nomatch_msg.message: The text loaded so far was readable, but no sentences matched your current question and concepts. On feeds or pages that load content as you scroll, keep scrolling to load more; the extension will scan new content and keep earlier results. You can also try broader terms.
empty_nomatch_msg.description: Empty state message when readable text had no matching sentences.

empty_pdf_denied_title.description: Empty state title when a PDF server denies access. Keep 'PDF' as-is.

empty_pdf_denied_msg.message: The PDF server denied access to the extension, so it couldn’t read this file in the tab. Download the PDF and use Scan saved PDF instead.
empty_pdf_denied_msg.description: Empty state message when a PDF server denies access. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

empty_blocked_title.message: Chrome did not allow access to this page
empty_blocked_title.description: Empty state title when Chrome blocks the extension from reading a site.

empty_blocked_msg.message: Chrome blocked the extension from reading this site. Open chrome://extensions, find Agate: Academic Evidence Highlighter, choose Details → Site access, then allow access on this site. You can also download the article PDF and use Scan saved PDF.
empty_blocked_msg.description: Empty state message when Chrome blocks site access. Keep 'chrome://extensions' and the product name as-is. 'Details → Site access' is a Chrome settings path; translate the path words to match the localized Chrome UI. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

empty_scan_failed_title.message: This page could not be scanned
empty_scan_failed_title.description: Empty state title when a scan fails with an unexpected error.

empty_scan_failed_msg.message: The extension could not read the page ($1). If this is an article, try its full-text page or download the PDF and use Scan saved PDF.
empty_scan_failed_msg.description: Empty state message when a scan fails. $1 is the browser error text, shown verbatim and never translated. 'Scan saved PDF' is the Scan saved PDF button label.

empty_paused_cleared_msg.message: Current results and page highlights were cleared. Resume scanning to scan eligible pages again.
empty_paused_cleared_msg.description: Empty state message after pausing, when results and highlights were cleared.

empty_scholarly_title.message: This page wasn’t recognized as scholarly
empty_scholarly_title.description: Empty state title when a page is not recognized as scholarly in Scholarly pages only mode.

empty_scholarly_msg.message: Scholarly pages only is on, so the extension did not read or scan this page. The address may still belong to an article that our checks don’t recognize. Choose Scan this page once only if you want to scan it, or switch Automatic scanning to Any page.
empty_scholarly_msg.description: Empty state message for a skipped non-scholarly page. 'Scholarly pages only', 'Scan this page once', 'Automatic scanning', and 'Any page' are UI labels; use their translated forms.

action_use_any_page.description: Empty state button that switches automatic scanning to Any page mode. 'Any page' is the scan mode name; use its translated form.

empty_filter_title.message: Matches were found, but the current filter is hiding them
empty_filter_title.description: Empty state title when the current filter hides all matches.

empty_filter_msg_one.message: The scan found $1 candidate sentence. Your Show filter is set to “$2,” which hides all of them. Show all including references to view every match.
empty_filter_msg_one.description: Empty state message when exactly one match is hidden by the filter. $1 is the number 1. $2 is the current filter option label, shown verbatim and never translated separately. 'Show' is the filter dropdown label and 'Show all including references' is a filter option; use their translated forms.

empty_filter_msg_many.message: The scan found $1 candidate sentences. Your Show filter is set to “$2,” which hides all of them. Show all including references to view every match.
empty_filter_msg_many.description: Empty state message when more than one match is hidden by the filter. $1 is the count. $2 is the current filter option label, shown verbatim and never translated separately. 'Show' is the filter dropdown label and 'Show all including references' is a filter option; use their translated forms.

filter_fallback_label.description: Fallback filter label used only if no filter option is selected.

action_show_all.description: Empty state button that shows all matches including references.

confirm_resume_text.message: Scanning is paused. Resume scanning and scan this page now? This will turn off Pause scanning.
confirm_resume_text.description: Fallback confirmation text used only when the paused-scan dialog is unavailable. 'Pause scanning' is the pause button label.

field_short_summary.description: Label for the short summary line on a result card, and CSV column header.

field_concepts.description: Label for the concepts line on a result card, and CSV column header.

field_matched.description: Label for the matched terms line on a result card.

field_pdf_page.description: Label for the PDF page line on a result card, and CSV column header. Keep 'PDF' as-is.

value_unknown.description: Fallback shown on a result card when a field value is missing.

value_na.description: Shown on a result card when no terms matched.

fallback_candidate.description: Fallback label for a result pill when no confidence value exists.

aria_show_candidate.description: Accessible label for a result card that can be focused in the paper. $1 is the candidate number.

page_note_no_highlight.message: Text scanned from the page. In-page highlighting isn’t available for this layout.
page_note_no_highlight.description: Note shown on a result card when in-page highlighting is unavailable.

button_show_highlight.description: Button on a result card that jumps to the highlight in the page.

csv_extracted_answer.description: CSV column header for the extracted answer terms.

csv_evidence_type.description: CSV column header for the evidence type.

csv_confidence.description: CSV column header for the confidence level.

csv_evidence_sentence.description: CSV column header for the evidence sentence.

csv_page_title.description: CSV column header for the page title.

csv_url.description: CSV column header for the page URL. Keep 'URL' as-is.

summary_food.description: Generated summary template for food questions. $1 is the user's first concept, shown verbatim and never translated. $2 is food text extracted from the paper, shown verbatim and never translated. Only the words 'may eat' and the period are translated; you may reorder the placeholders to fit your language's word order.

summary_care.description: Generated summary template for care questions. $1 is care text extracted from the paper, shown verbatim and never translated. Only the words 'Key care point' are translated.

summary_relation.description: Generated summary template for relationship questions. $1 is the user's first concept and $3 is the user's second concept, both shown verbatim and never translated. $2 is a direction phrase from direction_increase, direction_decrease, direction_unclear, or direction_general. You may reorder the placeholders to fit your language's word order, but all three placeholders must appear exactly once.

direction_increase.message: may increase or be positively related to
direction_increase.description: Direction phrase used inside summary_relation when the sentence suggests an increase or positive relation.

direction_decrease.message: may decrease or be negatively related to
direction_decrease.description: Direction phrase used inside summary_relation when the sentence suggests a decrease or negative relation.

direction_unclear.message: may not be clearly related to
direction_unclear.description: Direction phrase used inside summary_relation when the sentence suggests no clear relation.

direction_general.description: Direction phrase used inside summary_relation as the default.

tag_high.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.

tag_medium.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.

tag_low.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.

tag_reference.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.

tag_care_guidance.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.

tag_relationship.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.

tag_candidate_evidence.description: Card tag display text only; the logic value stays English.
